'''Jordi Mestres i López''' (born 1967, [[Girona]]) is a Catalan [[Chemist|chemical]] researcher who works in the field of research for molecules of pharmacological interest. He is also an active researcher as a [[genealogist]].

== Early life ==
Jordi Mestres was a student at [[Escolania de Montserrat]] (1977–1981). In 1990 he obtained a degree in chemistry from the [[Autonomous University of Barcelona]] (UAB) and in 1995 a doctorate in [[Computational chemistry|chemistry]] (computational chemistry) from the University of Girona (UdG),<ref>{{Cite thesis|author=Mestres, Jordi|title=Structural, electronic and mechanistic aspects of hydrogen (h-/h./h+) transfers. From the simplest model to the enzymic and non-enzymic processes|url=https://dialnet.unirioja.es/servlet/tesis?codigo=263829|date=1996|language=en}}</ref> with short research stays at the [[Paris-Sud University|Université de Paris-Sud]] (1992), [[Rice University]] (1993) and the pharmaceutical company Upjohn Co. ( [[Kalamazoo, Michigan|Kalamazoo]], United States; 1995).

== Research in chemistry ==
In parallel to his research in the field of quantum chemistry, he headed towards the computational design of drugs, with a post-doctoral stay at the company [[:en:Pharmacia & Upjohn|Pharmacia & Upjohn]] ( [[Kalamazoo, Michigan|Kalamazoo]], United States ).

In 1997 he joined NV Organon as a researcher ( [[Oss]], [[Netherlands]] ) and three years later was appointed Director of Computational Medical Chemistry at Organon Laboratories (Newhouse, United Kingdom ). In 2003 he started the Chemiogenomics Research Group of the Municipal Institute of Medical Research (IMIM), where he has been a researcher until 2023. He has been an associate professor at [[Pompeu Fabra University]] (UPF).

In 2006 he founded the company Chemotargets SL,<ref>{{Cite web|last=Bruguera|first=Laia|date=2023-09-14|title=Recerca avançada – 10 ago 2021|url=https://www.elpuntavui.cat/societat/article/14-salut/2012461-recerca-avancada.html|access-date=2023-09-14|language=ca}}</ref> which has developed benchmark software in the field of pharmacology prediction and molecule safety,<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-04-15|title=Chemotargets gira del software a la biotecnología|url=https://www.lavanguardia.com/economia/20200416/48550228371/chemotargets-gira-del-software-a-la-biotecnologia.html|access-date=2023-09-16|language=es}}</ref> used, for example, by the American regulatory agency of the drug ( [[Food and Drug Administration|FDA]] ).<ref name="Parc Científic de Barcelona 2020 h742">{{Cite web|date=2020-05-04|title=La FDA compra la llicència del software CLARITY de ChemotargetsParc Científic de Barcelona|url=https://www.pcb.ub.edu/la-fda-compra-la-llicencia-del-software-clarity-de-chemotargets/|access-date=2023-09-13|website=Parc Científic de Barcelona|language=ca}}</ref>

Between 2010 and 2016 he was editor of the journal Molecular Informatics.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Baumann|first=Knut|last2=Ecker|first2=Gerhard F.|last3=Mestres|first3=Jordi|last4=Schneider|first4=Gisbert|date=2010-01-12|title=Molecular Informatics – From Models to Molecules and Systems|url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/minf.201000271|journal=Molecular Informatics|language=en|volume=29|issue=1–2|pages=9–9|doi=10.1002/minf.201000271|issn=1868-1743|doi-access=free}}</ref>

== Research in genealogy ==
In the field of genealogy, Jordi Mestres has received training from [[Armand de Fluvià]], he has a master's degree in nobility and prize law, heraldry and genealogy from the [[National University of Distance Education]] (UNED), under the direction of Jaime de Salazar, and is a member of the board of the [[Catalan Institute of Genealogy and Heraldry]] . His area of genealogical research focuses mainly on lineages from the Girona counties,<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Mestres de la Meana|first=Jordi|date=2020|title=Els privilegis de generositat concedits per Ferran II el Catòlic|url=https://raco.cat/index.php/Armoria/article/view/410412|journal=Armoria|language=ca|issue=9|pages=155–167|issn=2696-0966}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Mestres de la Meana|first=Jordi|date=2021|title=Genealogia de Joaquim Ruyra i Oms|url=https://raco.cat/index.php/Armoria/article/view/411027|journal=Armoria|language=ca|issue=10|pages=143–160|issn=2696-0966}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Mestres de la Meana|first=Jordi|date=2021|title=Genealogia de Santiago Sobrequés i Vidal|url=https://raco.cat/index.php/Armoria/article/view/411029|journal=Armoria|language=ca|issue=10|pages=171–195|issn=2696-0966}}</ref> but he has also investigated Asturian lineages.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=López|first=Beatriz|last2=Mestres de la Meana|first2=Jordi|date=2017|title=La rama Gijonesa del linaje Maliayés de la Meana. parte I: Reconstrucción documentada de una genealogía ochocentista inventada|url=https://raco.cat/index.php/Armoria/article/view/408150|journal=Armoria|language=ca|issue=6|pages=75–111|issn=2696-0966}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=López|first=Beatriz|last2=Mestres de la Meana|first2=Jordi|date=2018|title=La rama Gijonesa del linaje Maliayés de la Meana. parte II: Reconstrucción documentada de una genealogía ochocentista inventada|url=https://raco.cat/index.php/Armoria/article/view/408278|journal=Armoria|language=ca|issue=7|pages=107–142|issn=2696-0966}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=López|first=Beatriz|last2=Mestres de la Meana|first2=Jordi|date=2019|title=La rama gijonesa del linaje maliayés De la Meana. Parte III: genealogía descendente del progenitor del linaje, Gutierre Fernández de la Meana|url=https://raco.cat/index.php/Armoria/article/view/410382|journal=Armoria|language=ca|issue=8|pages=17–71|issn=2696-0966}}</ref> He has also worked in the field of genetic genealogy.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Mestres de la Meana|first=Jordi|date=2017|title=Caracterització genètica de llinatges.|url=https://raco.cat/index.php/Armoria/article/view/411686|journal=Armoria|language=ca|issue=6|pages=119–132|issn=2696-0966}}</ref> He is the author of the book that collects the tree of sides, up to the sixth generation, of 100 protagonists in the history of Girona and the regions born between 1813 and 1927.

== Awards and honors ==
His research in drug design was recognized in 2006 with the international Corwin Hansch award given by the QSAR, Chemoinformatics and Modeling Society<ref>{{Cite web|last=Calsina|first=Marta|title=Jordi Mestres guanya el Corwin Hansch Award 2006 de la QSAR and Modelling Society – Notícies|url=https://www.imim.cat/|access-date=2023-09-09|language=ca}}</ref> and more recently with his admission as a [[Fellow of the Royal Society|Fellow]] of the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]].<ref name="La Mesa de los Notables 2018 q3792">{{Cite web|date=2018-07-07|title=El Doctor Jordi Mestres, admitido como Miembro De La Royal Society Of Chemistry.|url=http://lamesadelosnotables.blogspot.com/2018/07/el-doctor-jordi-mestres-caballero-del.html|access-date=2023-09-13|website=La Mesa de los Notables|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=adminpcb|date=2018-07-04|title=Jordi Mestres, 'Fellow' de la Royal Society of Chemistry|url=https://www.pcb.ub.edu/jordi-mestres-fellow-de-la-royal-society-of-chemistry/|access-date=2023-09-14|language=ca}}</ref> His company Chemotargets was awarded in 2007 by the Social Council of Pompeu Fabra University.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Premis del Consell Social de la UPF, curs 2006/2007|url=https://www.upf.edu/documents/113521321/113573308/quadre_guany_tc07.pdf/f9d8da4f-a79e-ebb6-6707-5efc667a2be9|access-date=16 September 2023|language=ca}}</ref> In 2021, he was considered one of the eight most influential researchers in the Barcelona Biomedical Research Park (PRBB).<ref>{{Cite web|last=Antoja|first=Gemma|date=2021-12-23|title=Vuit investigadors i investigadores del PRBB entre els més influents del món|url=https://ellipse.prbb.org/ca/vuit-investigadors-i-investigadores-del-prbb-entre-els-mes-influents-del-mon/|access-date=2023-09-09|language=ca}}</ref> He is chair of the organizing committee of the [https://www.qsar.org QSAR, Cheminformatics and Modeling Society's] 24th European Symposium on Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationships in [[Barcelona]] in 2024.<ref>{{Cite web|title=24th EuroQSAR / Barcelona, Spain – September 22–26, 2024|url=https://www.euroqsar.org/|access-date=2023-09-18}}</ref> He is a member of the Scientific Advisory Board of ChemBioFrance<ref>{{Cite web|last=Calsina|first=Marta|title=Jordi Mestres nomenat membre del Consell Científic de ChemBioFrance – Notícies|url=https://www.imim.cat/|access-date=2023-09-09|language=ca}}</ref> and of the [[Chemical Abstracts Service]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=CAS convenes life sciences advisory board to reimagine the future of scientific discovery {{!}} CAS|url=https://www.cas.org/resources/press-releases/cas-convenes-life-sciences-advisory-board-reimagine-future-scientific|access-date=2023-09-09|language=en}}</ref>
